title: Product Hardy Spaces on Spaces of Homogeneous Type: Discrete Product Calderón-Type Reproducing Formula, Atomic Characterization, and Product Calderón--Zygmund Operators
summary: Let $i\in\{1,2\}$ and $X_i$ be a space of homogeneous type in the sense of Coifman and Weiss with the upper dimension $ω_i$. Also let $η_i$ be the smoothness index of the Auscher--Hytönen wavelet function $ψ^{k_i}_{α_i}$ on $X_i$. In this article, for any $p\in(\max\{\frac{ω_1}{ω_1+η_1},\frac{ω_2}{ω_2+η_2}\}, 1]$, by regarding the product Carleson measure space $\mathrm{CMO}^p_{L^2}(X_1\times X_2)$ as the test function space and its dual space $(\mathrm{CMO}^p_{L^2}(X_1\times X_2))'$ as the corresponding distribution space, we introduce the product Hardy space $H^p(X_1\times X_2)$ in terms…
